elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Section (c) applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Statement of Work for any reason” and requires Contractor, at Company's request, to “provide reasonable transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six (6) months.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(i) expressly provides transition assistance “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(i) states that assistance will be provided “at Contractor's then-current rates.”

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(ii) requires Contractor to “return to Company all Works, Company data and Confidential Information in Contractor's possession or control.” “Company data” satisfies the Customer Data requirement.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(ii) requires return “within thirty (30) days of such expiry or termination.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(ii) requires return “in a commonly used, machine-readable format,” which satisfies the standard machine-readable-format requirement.

elements.element: Vendor must delete Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(iii) requires Contractor to “thereafter delete all such data and Confidential Information from its systems.” “Thereafter” sequences deletion after the required return.

elements.element: Vendor must certify deletion of Customer Data after deletion.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(iii) requires Contractor to “certify such deletion to Company in writing.”

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(i) imposes transition assistance upon expiry or termination of the Agreement or any Statement of Work.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for ninety (90) days.
elements.evidence: The assistance period of up to six months encompasses and exceeds the fallback ninety-day period.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must export Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(ii) requires Contractor to return Company data to Company in a commonly used, machine-readable format, satisfying the data-export requirement.

elements.element: Customer Data must be exported within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(ii) expressly requires the return within thirty days of the applicable expiry or termination.

result.reason: The operative language satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also the fallback. It is not minimal because it expands the required return and deletion beyond Customer Data to all Works and Confidential Information and applies upon termination or expiry of any individual Statement of Work. That broader trigger also creates a material conflict risk: ending one Statement of Work requires return and deletion of all Company data and Confidential Information even if another Statement of Work remains active and requires those materials. The clause should limit the obligation to termination or expiry of the Agreement, or to data and materials associated with the affected Statement of Work.
